$comment: Sarvam AI's own published rates, from https://docs.sarvam.ai/api-reference-docs/pricing (mirrored at https://www.sarvam.ai/api-pricing). Not a third-party aggregator. Every stage of the pipeline runs on Sarvam today, so this is the only pricing source needed right now — kept as one file per provider so adding a second provider later is a new file, not a rewrite of this one. Latest-wins, like LiteLLM's model_prices_and_context_window.json: a price change here is a plain overwrite, not a new dated row. What must never move is cost_micros already written into credit_ledger — that's resolved and snapshotted at charge time, so an edit here can never retroactively change a past charge.

stt.label: Speech to Text
stt.billing_note: Billed per second of audio, rounded up.

stt_diarization.label: Speech to Text + Diarization
stt_diarization.billing_note: Billed per second of audio, rounded up. Adds speaker identification over plain STT.

stt_translate.label: Speech to Text + Translate
stt_translate.billing_note: Billed per second of audio, rounded up. Transcription and translation in one call — could replace separate STT+MT stages if the pipeline switches to it.

stt_translate_diarization.label: Speech to Text + Translate + Diarization
stt_translate_diarization.billing_note: Billed per second of audio, rounded up.

tts_bulbul_v3.label: Text to Speech (Bulbul v3)
tts_bulbul_v3.billing_note: Billed per character, rounded up to the nearest 10K block.
